character.name: Sovia Rabocheva
character.description: Fictional interdimensional broadcaster in the Soviet scientific town of Troitsk who reinterprets music received from other worlds.
quotes: I'm not very good at speaking in front of a crowd… But over the radio, perhaps I can.
signatureLines: Comrades, see you tomorrow, see you next week.
character.biography: An interdimensional broadcaster in the science city who arranges music received from other worlds.
character.identity: Interdimensional broadcaster in the science city
character.worldOrigin: The world of the interdimensional radio station

relationships.description: Kata is like an older sister to Sovia and is also a leader at the Academy of Sciences.
Sovia and the in-universe Runa seem able to sense each other.
QI-7 found Sovia interesting and began imitating her.
